items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t know Louis Hayes well until after I’d gotten in Basie’s band.

ctx.x: Louis Hayes, you said he was around Detroit? And then we’re going to figure out how you got from Detroit -- why did you join the Army? But Louis Hayes? Is there anything you want to say about him?
I didn’t know Louis Hayes well until after I’d gotten in Basie’s band.
So he was just another cat around?
